data.body: Fix landed in Gerrit change 2863 as merged commit 04b762a1cbf4d5218652ec7739e54904da3eabae. Verification: RED test tests/interfaces/io/test_import_batch_resume.py::test_import_checks_publishability_once_per_batch_commit failed on unmodified code with 20 per-event publishability checks for 10 CREATE+COMMENT records; GREEN targeted run passed 15 tests including the new regression, the import benchmark, and tests/unit/test_gate_store_freshness.py; full make verify PYTEST_WORKERS=8 passed with ambient GIT_CONFIG_* unset and short non-/tmp TMPDIR=/Users/joeoakhart/.copilot/t. Prior verify attempts with TMPDIR under the worktree and a long session path were environment artifacts (shellcheck scanned pytest scratch under .rebar/tmp; forkserver AF_UNIX path too long), both confirmed and corrected before the passing verify.
